profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer @ General Dynamics Information Technology | Full Stack Engineer | UI Developer | Frontend Developer | Angular 20+, Dot Net Core, Power BI
profile.geoLocationName: Cherry Hill, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
As a Senior Software Developer at General Dynamics Information Technology, I bring over ten years of experience supporting the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) through the design and development of robust web applications and data-driven solutions. My core expertise includes Angular 22+, .NET Core, and Power BI, with a strong focus on modernizing and migrating legacy systems such as the FAA Airport Safety and Wildlife Strike Databases. My work has significantly improved user interfaces, streamlined data management, and enabled more efficient decision-making for critical aviation safety operations.
With over 20 years of experience in application development, I specialize in full-stack software engineering, spanning modern frontend frameworks and scalable backend architectures. I am committed to delivering secure, high-quality, and maintainable solutions that align with organizational objectives. My collaborative mindset, attention to detail, and ability to adapt quickly ensure successful integration of new technologies to meet complex business needs in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
•	FAA Airport Safety Database - ASD (asd.faa.gov) – Website: (FAA Airport Technology Research & Development)
o	Technologies: Angular 18+, Dot Net Core, HTML, Bootstrap, SQL server 2018, DevOps/Agile development, Git, Power BI and ag-grid.
o	Migration from Oracle database to SQL server database and user interface using Font End Framework Angular 18+, Bootstrap, CSS, HTML, ag-grid for grid data view and Web Services (API) using Dot Net Core framework.
•	FAA Wildlife Strike Database (wildlife.faa.gov) – Website: (FAA Airport Technology Research & Development)
o	Technologies: Angular 18, Asp.Net, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, SQL server 2016, TFS, VSTS and ag-grid.
o	Implemented user interface using Font End Framework Angular 18, Bootstrap, CSS and HTML and Web Services using C# to communicate with user interfaces and MS SQL Server Database with stored procedure for Strike reporting and management of Strikes.
•	Wildlife – Web services/API: (FAA Airport Technology Research & Development)
o	Created Restful web services to report a wildlife strike report, update a strike report-by-report number. 
o	Each incoming request is validated using token-based authentication and keep track of in and out request in database logs.
•	Wildlife Legacy Website: (FAA Airport Technology Research & Development)
o	Created USDA Backlog tool using to speedup processing of strike from their end with help of MS Access and VBA.
•	Foreign Object Debris (FOD) (fod.faa.gov): (FAA Airport Technology Research & Development)
o	Reviewed the current code apply optimization and enhancement of user interface using Bootstrap, HTML and CSS. 
•	Pave Air (https://faapaveair.faa.gov/): (FAA Airport Technology Research & Development)
o	Reviewed the current code apply optimization and enhancement of some modules like PCI calculation. 
•	Dynamic Query DNN Module: 
o	Created a DNN module to support dynamic query where user can write select query, display results in grid view and export to excel.

positions.title: Software Enginner
positions.description:
•	Check-Net Hybrid Mobile App :
o	Technologies: AngularJS, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Telerik App builder with Mobile UI, C#, RESTFUL APIs, PhoneGap and Cordova, and GitHub for version control.
o	Developed hybrid mobile application using Telerik App builder with Apache Cordova that can run natively on android and iOS devices with the option expand to Windows phone etc.
o	Used AngularJS as the development framework to build a single-page application.
o	Application supports Telerik Analytics with options expand to Google Analytics.
•	Check-Net Web application: 
o	Technologies: MVC4, C#, LINQ, Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, RESTFUL Web APIs, JQuery, JQuery UI, JSON, Required JS, Type Scripts, Knockout.Js, Telerik Kendo UI, Entity Framework, SQL server, SSRS, and Team Foundation Server for version control.
o	Created a custom, responsive MVC web application to replace a legacy line-of-business web application using Bootstrap, where user can login and place their orders online.
o	Application worked across mobile devices and modern desktop browsers and multilingual.
•	Check-Net New Customer Signup System:
o	Technologies: MVC 5, C#, LINQ, Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, RESTFUL Web APIs, JQuery, JQuery UI, JSON, Telerik Kendo UI, Entity Framework, SQL server, and Team Foundation Server for version control.
o	Worked with business development team to understand and define common data and components.
o	Created a custom, responsive MVC web application using Bootstrap where new customer can apply using new account signup (on boarding) process and existing user can add new retailer access.
•	Accrual Management System:
o	Technologies: ASP.Net, SQL Server 2008, SQL server reporting Service, Entity Framework, SQL server, and Team Foundation Server for version control.
o	Accrual report is small full stack version of project, it’s mainly used for Account department month end process to know orders produced and not shipped within the accrual time.

positions.description:

•	Sales Support System:

o	Created reports using Data Reports.

•	Instrument Calibration System: 
o	Desktop application developed for Garden Silk Mill, Surat using VB6 includes calibration of instruments with master data and create calibration certificate.
o	Created reports using Data Reports.
o	Understands business / customer requirements, create mockup screens, and create user interface, deployment on local server, support and training to end user and unit testing.
